title: Welcome to NUM-CORE
description: Start by reading the README.md to understand the project's purpose: a core engine for numerical methods with both GUI and CLI interfaces.

title: Application Entry Point
description: The main entry point for the Python application is main.py. It initializes the environment and launches either the GUI dashboard or the Terminal interface.

title: Core Numerical Engine
description: The numerical engine contains specialized solvers for root finding, regression, and calculus. These are found in the numcore_engine/solvers directory.

title: GUI Dashboard
description: The graphical interface is built with PyQt/PySide. The dashboard.py file manages the main layout and navigation between different numerical method pages.

title: Visualization and Plotting
description: Visualization is key for numerical methods. The visualization.py module handles dynamic Matplotlib plots and animations for root finding and interpolation.

title: MATLAB Edition
description: For users preferring MATLAB, a complete implementation is available in the matlab/ directory, featuring its own menu-driven UI and equivalent solver implementations.

title: Verification and Testing
description: The project includes an extensive test suite. integration/test_app_flow.py verifies the complete application lifecycle across both CLI and GUI paths.
